content.short: Gala Games is an Ethereum-based decentralized gaming studio that builds play-to-earn NFT games.
content.description: Gala Games offers an ecosystem of play-to-earn crypto and NFT games across various genres on the Ethereum blockchain. The platform is decentralized, with more than 16,000 players running Gala nodes to help secure and steward the network. Players use the native GALA token for in-game purchases, peer-to-peer trading within the Gala ecosystem, and to claim rewards that are issued in GALA. Notable titles include Townstar and VOX, and a growing lineup of new games and experiences are in active development.
